title: Rewire item resolution to match on scope, kind, and self-id
description:
Wire the address parser and sugar expansion into every place that currently resolves a qualified id via `split_qualified_id`, so resolution filters by kind in addition to scope and self-id — closing the collision this work exists to fix (e.g. a `rule` and a `gate` both named `coverage-preview` no longer resolve to whichever happens to match first).

Update:
- `commands/item.rs::show_item` (`commands/item.rs:291-353`, `split_qualified_id` call at line 292): accept the full grammar — parse an explicit-kind address directly, or run the sugar expansion for a plain `<short-id>/<self-id>` input — then filter items by BOTH `kind == parsed_kind` and `self_id == parsed_self_id` (today it only checks `i.self_id == self_id` at lines ~303 and ~338). Per plan amendment D3-A, pattern-ambiguous or pattern-unmatched sugar defers to the indexed items (single match resolves, multi-item collision errors) instead of surfacing the inference error.
- `commands/item.rs::resolve_link_label` (`commands/item.rs:384-412`, call at line 402): update the "is this value a qualified reference" check to the new grammar (a plain 2-segment sugar value still counts as qualified).
- `commands/validate.rs::dangling_link_findings` (`commands/validate.rs:288-339`, call at line 317): same qualified-value check update, so dangling-link detection keeps working for every address form.
- `validation/graph.rs::label_credits_id` (`validation/graph.rs:70-96`, call at line 90): update ONLY enough to compile against the new parser's signature. Do NOT add kind-filtering to this function's matching semantics — it must keep crediting `satisfies:<scope>/<self-id>` purely on scope + self-id equality, unchanged, since the `satisfies:REQ-NN` coverage mechanism is explicitly out of scope for kind-awareness (binding decision: confirmed unaffected, its qualified path only shares the updated parser in lockstep).

Once all four call sites are migrated, remove `split_qualified_id` (`domain/item.rs:678-680`) and update `test_split_qualified_id_roundtrip` (`domain/item.rs:1414-1419`) to exercise the new parser instead, completing the replacement.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `show_item` resolves `@/<kind>/<self-id>`, `@/issue/<short-id>/<kind>/<self-id>`, and `<short-id>/<self-id>` sugar. Explicit-kind addresses filter candidates by kind AND self-id; a test constructs two same-scope, same-self-id, different-kind `AddressableItem`s (e.g. a `rule` and a `gate` both self-id `coverage-preview`) and asserts each explicit-kind address resolves to its own distinct item. Sugar resolution follows plan amendment D3-A: when kind inference is unambiguous the inferred kind filters as above; when the sugar self-id's pattern inference is ambiguous or matches no kind pattern, resolution defers to the indexed items of the issue scope — exactly one item carrying that self-id resolves, several colliding items produce a clear multi-kind collision error, never a silent first match.
- [hard] REQ-02: a request for a kind that does not own the matched self-id in that scope (e.g. asking for `@/gate/<self-id-that-is-actually-a-rule>`) is a clear "not found" error, never a silent fallback to a different kind's item; covered by a unit test.
- [hard] REQ-03: `resolve_link_label` and `dangling_link_findings` (`commands/validate.rs:288-339`) correctly classify every one of the three address forms (including sugar) as qualified references, verified by unit tests per form.
- [hard] REQ-04: `label_credits_id` (`validation/graph.rs:70-96`) compiles against the new parser and its existing coverage-credit tests still pass unmodified (scope+self-id-only matching, no kind filter added).
- [hard] REQ-05: `split_qualified_id` (`domain/item.rs:678-680`) is removed from the codebase (no remaining references outside its own now-updated test), and `cargo build --workspace` / `cargo test --lib` pass with zero new clippy warnings.

## Amendment note (plan D3-A, invoker-approved 2026-07-03)

The original REQ-01 wording required kind-filtered resolution for ALL forms including sugar. The live config's `requirement` id-pattern is the deliberately generic `[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+`, which also matches `D-NN`/`RISK-NN`, so pure pattern inference is ambiguous for every non-REQ sugar self-id. Plan amendment D3-A (recorded in `dev/active/2821e177-2d2d-4b25-b64a-4f38723e7fe6-plan.md` §Amendments) therefore adopts item-backed disambiguation for sugar: the pure `expand_sugar_address` function keeps its strict ambiguity error; the resolution call site falls back to the actual indexed items, erroring only on a genuine multi-item collision. The legacy kind-agnostic project form `@/<self-id>` remains resolvable as an explicitly-commented transitional path, removed by story 7f22d6cf REQ-04 (amendment D11-A).
